excluded.drop_reason: physics (measured 2026-09-10): the fiducial region's 9 GeV leading-lepton threshold makes PIXEL's Born acceptance identically zero below m_ll = 18 GeV, because at Born both leptons carry p_T = (m/2) sin(theta*). The first published mass bin (12-17 GeV) therefore predicts exactly zero and the next is cut into. Curing that needs the recoil (q_T) correction to the acceptance, which PIXEL does not implement; nnpdf40_native.py records 'recoil bound required' (bound 9.4e-2, measured 2026-08-24). Edges, sqrts, cuts and the mass-spectrum builder are all present, so this is the only gate.
